svg.title: Three joins of a record to market outcomes
svg.desc: The Callaway and Coastcast example as two dated lanes, then three studies with their sample windows, joined records, timing rules and reported results.
svg.text: Three joins of a record to market outcomes, each made under a rule that kept
The pieces sat in separate places: a customer named in a supplier’s filing, an insider’s own trading history, cars counted from orbit.
Each study’s contribution was the join. All three are retrospective and observational.

Earnings of minus 4 cents a share
The fact that its largest customer had lost 30 percent of its value was public for weeks before the supplier’s price reflected it.
THREE STUDIES, THEIR SAMPLE WINDOWS AND THEIR JOINS
Record joined: customers named in segment files when they take more
than 10 percent of a firm’s sales, matched to listed companies by
phonetic matching and then by hand.
Rule: a six-month gap between fiscal year-end and the returns used.

Sources: Cohen and Frazzini 2008, Journal of Finance 63; Cohen, Malloy and Pomorski 2010, NBER Working Paper 16454; Katona, Painter, Patatoukas
